result.title: GTSM: Gaussian Splatting with Thermal State-Space Dynamics for Spatio-Temporal Thermal Field Reconstruction and Prediction
result.summary: Temperature-field reconstruction and prediction are important for condition monitoring, process analysis, and state assessment in industrial and dynamic environments. This work aims to recover a four-dimensional spatio-temporal thermal state field directly from two-dimensional observations, without requiring a predefined 3D model, prescribed thermodynamic equation, or predefined heating/cooling trajectory. To this end, we propose the Gaussian Thermal State-Space Model (GTSM), which represents thermal evolution through a shared scene-level latent process and Gaussian-specific local thermal states. The resulting continuous dynamics are propagated using differentiable RK2 integration, allowing thermal evolution to be inferred from multi-view and multi-temporal observations and continuously extrapolated beyond the observed interval. GTSM is designed as a backbone-agnostic thermal dynamics module for Gaussian representations and can be integrated with both static 3D Gaussian Splatting and dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting, supporting thermal reconstruction and prediction under both static and time-varying target geometry. The reconstructed representation further enables novel-view thermal rendering and future-time thermal-state prediction. Experiments on real infrared sequences and synthetic dynamic thermal data demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and substantially stronger temporal extrapolation than representative baselines, while also validating the applicability of GTSM to deforming targets.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GTSM：以共享的场景级 latent 过程配合各高斯局部热状态构成连续状态空间动力学，用可微 RK2 积分从多视角、多时刻二维红外观测重建四维温度场并外推到观测区间之外，可作为 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting 的骨干无关模块。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享 latent 过程＋局部状态＋连续时间积分外推」的结构可能为 latent 推理状态的演化更新与超观测区间外推（长度泛化）提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身面向热场重建，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。
